title: The Essential Role of Prolines and Their Conformation in Allosteric Regulation of Kaiso Zinc Finger DNA-Binding Activity by the Adjacent C-Terminal Loop.
authors: Belova, Elena; Maksimenko, Oksana; Georgiev, Pavel; Bonchuk, Artem
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和体外结合实验，研究Kaiso锌指蛋白C端脯氨酸构象对DNA结合活性的别构调控机制，属于TF-DNA互作机制建模研究，与本课题高度匹配。
abstract: Kaiso is a methyl-DNA-binding protein containing three C2H2 zinc fingers with a C-terminal extension that participates in DNA binding. The linker between the last zinc finger and the DNA-binding portion of the extension contains two prolines that are highly conserved in vertebrates and in cognate ZBTB4 and ZBTB38 proteins. Prolines provide chain rigidity and can exist in cis and trans conformations that can be switched by proline isomerases, affecting protein function. We found that substitution of the conserved proline P588, but not of P577, to alanine, negatively affected KaisoDNA-binding according to molecular dynamics simulation and in vitro DNA-binding assays. Molecular dynamics simulations of the Kaiso DNA-binding domain with P588 either substituted to alanine or switched to the cis-conformation revealed similar alterations in the H-bonding network and uncovered allosteric effects leading to structural rearrangements in the entire domain that resulted in the weakening of DNA-binding affinity. The substitution of proline with a large hydrophobic residue led to the same negative effects despite its ability to partially rescue the intrinsic DNA-binding activity of the C-terminal loop. Thus, the presence of the C-terminal extension and cis-conformation of proline residues are essential for efficient Kaiso-DNA binding, which likely involves intramolecular tension squeezing the DNA chain.
abstract_zh: Kaiso是一种含有三个C2H2锌指结构的甲基-DNA结合蛋白，其C端延伸参与DNA结合。最后一个锌指与延伸的DNA结合部分之间的连接区包含两个脯氨酸，这些脯氨酸在脊椎动物及同源的ZBTB4和ZBTB38蛋白中高度保守。脯氨酸赋予链刚性，并可以以顺式和反式构象存在，这些构象可被脯氨酸异构酶切换，从而影响蛋白质功能。我们发现，根据分子动力学模拟和体外DNA结合实验，将保守脯氨酸P588（而非P577）替换为丙氨酸，对Kaiso-DNA结合产生负面影响。对Kaiso DNA结合域中P588替换为丙氨酸或切换为顺式构象的分子动力学模拟显示，氢键网络发生类似改变，并揭示了变构效应，导致整个域的结构重排，从而削弱DNA结合亲和力。将脯氨酸替换为大疏水残基尽管能部分恢复C端环的内在DNA结合活性，但仍产生相同的负面效应。因此，C端延伸的存在和脯氨酸残基的顺式构象对于高效的Kaiso-DNA结合至关重要，这可能涉及挤压DNA链的分子内张力。
